articles.title: Watch: Denied chance to address CM, Cong MLA creates ruckus on stage
articles.description: A Congress MLA, Harish Dhami, vandalised a stage at the Jauljibi Fair after being denied a speaking opportunity. This incident triggered a political uproar between the Congress and the BJP following the chief minister's attendance. Harish Dhami claimed he was not allowed to raise local issues, including a recent tragic incident. The BJP condemned his behavior and demanded an FIR against him for using abusive language.

Travelling abroad? 35 days crucial if you want to make it to Census
articles.description: Indian residents travelling temporarily abroad during Census 2027 will be counted at their usual residence. They must return within 35 days to qualify for inclusion in the count. The online self-enumeration exercise will start on November 16 and last until November 30. Door-to-door enumeration will occur from December 1, 2026, to January 4, 2027. Final census data is expected to be released in April 2027.

articles.title: Chicago photographer's $220 thrift store paintings sell for $135,000 after rare discovery
articles.description: In an unexpected twist of fate, a photographer from Chicago stumbled upon two remarkable original pieces by Warner Sallman in a thrift store back in 2016. After investing $220 for them, his diligence paid off two years later when he sold the artworks to author Jerry Jenkins for an impressive $135,000, reshaping the market landscape for Sallman’s creations and showcasing the hidden treasures often overlooked in thrift shops.

articles.title: Hungarian investigators found $19.5 million in cash buried in forests and hidden in buildings while probing allegations against a former minister
articles.description: Hungary's anti-corruption efforts have yielded significant results, uncovering over $19.5 million in cash, stashed away in forests and hidden properties. Former minister Miklós Seszták faces bribery charges tied to the transport sector, while Prime Minister Peter Magyar's initiative seeks to address corruption issues involving the previous administration of Viktor Orbán. The Fidesz party has distanced itself from Seszták's allegations and calls for him to defend his reputation.

articles.title: Skeletons Cheer Cancer Patient: Ohio display encouraged Tammy during treatment; figures stay out year-round
articles.description: In Oxford, Ohio, Bill Pyle's Halloween skeleton display became a beacon of hope for Tammy during her cancer journey. After receiving a touching letter, Pyle arranged the skeletons to honor her final radiation treatment, which shifted his perspective and deepened community bonds. This display is now a year-round fixture, updated weekly, with an annual homage to Tammy, illustrating how simple decorations can uplift during tough times.

articles.title: ‘These tricks don’t work on me’: Eisenkot rejects Netanyahu’s 'unity govt' appeal
articles.description: Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reiterated his call for a national unity government. Gadi Eisenkot, his political rival, dismissed Netanyahu's appeal, viewing it as a strategy to create division. Eisenkot is currently negotiating to form his government, with a deadline of 28 days. Discussions are strained over the Knesset speaker election, with both sides presenting opposing candidates. Netanyahu's coalition proposal excludes Arab parties, complicating the negotiations ahead.

articles.title: Bad air, bigger bills: Air pollution drives health insurance claims up fourfold in 3 years
articles.description: In India, the demand for health insurance claims related to pollution has skyrocketed, witnessing a remarkable fourfold increase in just three years. Delhi tops the list for the highest claims, with other cities and smaller towns also reporting considerable figures.

articles.title: ‘Solid but unremarkable’: Goldman Sachs sees global GDP growth at 2.8% in 2027
articles.description: Global economic growth is projected at 2.8% in 2027, driven by declining energy prices and increased AI investments. Risks such as geopolitical tensions and fiscal pressures remain significant concerns for global growth.

articles.description: India's life insurance sector is expected to maintain healthy growth supported by increasing demand for protection products. articles.description: BSE Odisha has released the schedule for the upcoming Class 10 board examinations in 2027. The exams will take place from March 12 until March 27, starting each day at 9 am. State Open School Certificate and Sanskrit Madhyama examinations will be conducted concurrently with the regular exams.

articles.description: A major plot leak regarding the film 'Scene' forced the editing team to make changes before release. articles.title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's film earns over 3 times 'Animal'; crosses Rs 1,200 cr worldwide
articles.description: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has achieved remarkable box office success in its second week. After recording Rs 72.90 cr net on Day 10, the film's total domestic collection reached Rs 685.60 cr. Its worldwide gross has surpassed Rs 1,200 cr, demonstrating strong international performance as well. The Hindi version has been the largest contributor, followed by Kannada and Telugu releases.
